key_insight: ORCHID-SAGE makes CALPHAD assessments reproducible by recording expert judgments as formal protocols, not just publishing fitted parameters.
engineering_relevance: Traceable, regenerable thermodynamic databases could support reliable phase-stability predictions and evidence-driven updates for materials design and self-driving laboratories.
method: Encode assessment decisions in formal, reproducible protocols.
Record the path from evidence and model fitting to database predictions.
Test regeneration through a script, an MCP-only AI agent, and a public-source refit.
evidence_signal: For the initial Cr–Ni assessment, the abstract reports the same predictions after scripted regeneration on a second machine, MCP-only AI-agent regeneration, and refitting from public sources.
watch_item: Demonstration is limited to Cr–Ni; broader applicability and robust encoding of expert judgment remain to be established.
paper_title: ORCHID-SAGE: Fully Reproducible CALPHAD Assessment from Evidence to Phase Diagram
